BiblicalUsage: Nobai, written Nebai in Nehemiah 10:19, is one of the leaders who set his name to the covenant after the wall was rebuilt. He appears in the long list of signers in Nehemiah 10:19, a man whose only mark in Scripture is that he stood with the people who promised to keep God's law.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that signing your name to obedience is no small thing, and God remembers the people who stand up to be counted even when history forgets their stories.
